rows.text: Answering Unstarred Question 5063 on 29 August 1991, the Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs (Shri M.M. Jacob) enclosed 'A Statement regarding members of the National Integration Council last reconstituted in 1990', which lists under 'Leaders of National Parties recognised by the Election Commission' '33. Shri S.R. Bommai, President, Janata Dal', after '32. Shri Rajiv Gandhi, President, Indian National Congress'.

locator.section: answer to Unstarred Question 5063, Statement, item 33

bounded_scope: Party-office and organisation observations for CLAUDE-C01-33 only: the role in_jd_president (President of the Janata Dal) and the Janata Dal recognition observation in_eci_19980110_np_06. In-office attestations, continuations, working presidencies, rival claims, removals claimed, recollections, retrospective spans, the Election Commission's dispute orders and table entries stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Rows about the organisation carry role_id null and holder_name null. The Prime Minister, the President of India, ministers, chief ministers, parliamentary leaders, state-unit presidents, the Rashtriya Janata Dal, the Janata Dal (Secular), the Janata Dal (United), the Janata Dal (A) and every other office or organisation are excluded as holders.
